3.0.0.subtitle: First update in 5 months, curius if theres anyone still using this tool.
changes: Fixed PVP
Rune crafting automation added (as a request from a user)
Major restructuring of the codebase
Removed side panel, added help button for command details
Added a what's new popup for the first time after updating

3.0.1.subtitle: First update in 5 months, curius if theres anyone still using this tool.
changes: Fixed PVP
Rune crafting automation added (as a request from a user)
Major restructuring of the codebase
Removed side panel, added help button for command details
Added a what's new popup for the first time after updating
Fixed Cavern command not passing selected dungeons
Replaced custom tab buttons with native CTkTabview for cleaner UI
Fixed launcher not showing What's New dialog after launcher self-update

3.0.2.subtitle: Small quality-of-life fixes.
changes: Updated cavern image and fixed its screen region
Activity Hub now fails faster if a screen isn't found

3.0.3.subtitle: Live view performance and update fixes.
changes: Live view no longer lags: frame rendering moved off the interface thread and stale frames are dropped
Removed the periodic battery check that briefly blocked the interface
Command logging no longer stutters the interface
What's New popup now appears after auto-updates (changelog is embedded in the exe)
Dungeon handling adjusted when no usable monsters remain
Slider retry attempts increased from 35 to 55

3.0.4.subtitle: Connection fixes.
changes: Connection errors now say what's actually wrong instead of just 'FAIL'
Detects unsupported Android versions (15+ doesn't work yet)

3.1.1.subtitle: Small monster command fix.
changes: Repeat monster command now waits for the egg to appear before taking it, so it no longer misses eggs

3.1.0.subtitle: Android 15 and 16 now work.
changes: Screen streaming now works on Android 15 and 16 (and 5.0 through 14)
Rebuilt the streaming library and bundled it into the app
If the stream drops, it reconnects on its own instead of stopping
Closing the game no longer gives a false 'Failed to close game' error
Pausing or cancelling a command logs a clear 'stopped' message instead of a blank error
